subject: gk
question:
Which of the following correctly describes Mission Shakti?

1. It is an integrated women empowerment programme launched in 2022.

2. It is run by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

3. The scheme includes Samarthya and Sambal sub-schemes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mission Shakti** is an integrated women empowerment programme launched by the Government of India in 2022.
 
• The programme is implemented by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** (MoWCD).
 
• It aims to promote gender equality and provide support for women's safety, security, and empowerment.
 
• The scheme includes two key sub-schemes: **Samarthya** (focusing on women’s empowerment) and **Sambal** (focusing on women’s safety and security).
 
• The scheme consolidates various existing initiatives and introduces new measures to address issues faced by women comprehensively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samarthya Sub-Scheme:** Focuses on women’s empowerment through skill development, education, and livelihood opportunities.
 
• **Sambal Sub-Scheme:** Aims to ensure safety and security for women through initiatives like One Stop Centres (OSCs), Women Helplines, and Beti Bachao Beti Padhao.
 
• **One Stop Centres (OSCs):** Provide integrated support and assistance to women affected by violence in both private and public spaces.
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** A component of Mission Shakti focused on addressing the declining child sex ratio and promoting the education of the girl child.
 
• **National Database on Women:** A proposed initiative under Mission Shakti to improve data collection and monitoring related to women’s welfare schemes.
